During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] established a '''work camp''' on the planet [[Kirtania]] for the purposes of harvesting valuable hardwoods from the [[Kinkosa rain forest|rain forest]]. It was destroyed by [[Araquia]]n tribesmen.
